workingTime.helpTitle: How the working time is measured
workingTime.helpTeam: A team's working time runs from the start of the run to the team's last answer. A team that joins later starts when it joins. Pauses of the run count, because the app keeps no record of them.
workingTime.helpTask: The time to an answer runs from the team's previous answer to this answer. It includes the way to the station. The median is the middle value: half of the teams were faster. The middle half gives the times between which the middle 50% of the teams lie.
workingTime.toggleTable: Show or hide the data table for the working time per team

create.title: New run
create.nameHelper: Appears in the list of runs.
create.scheduledStartHelperAuto: Optional. With a start time the run then starts on its own. Without one you start it by hand.
create.scheduledStartHelperManual: Optional. The start time is only a plan. You start the run by hand.
create.afterCreate: After you create the run, you see the join code and QR code and can share them. Teams can join once you start the run.
create.afterCreatePlanned: After you create the run, you see the join code and QR code and can share them. The run starts on its own at the planned time. Teams can join from then on.

joinWindow.paused: Teams cannot join during the pause. After “Resume” they can join again.
